let relu = { lambda ; a:f32[1,56,56,64]. let
    b:f32[1,56,56,64] = max a 0.0:f32[]
  in (b,) } in
{ lambda ; c:f32[1,56,56,64] d:f32[64] e:f32[64] f:f32[64] g:f32[64] h:f32[64] i:f32[64]
    j:f32[64] k:f32[64] l:f32[3,3,64,64] m:f32[3,3,64,64]. let
    n:f32[1,56,56,64] = conv_general_dilated[
      batch_group_count=1
      dimension_numbers=ConvDimensionNumbers(lhs_spec=(0, 3, 1, 2), rhs_spec=(3, 2, 0, 1), out_spec=(0, 3, 1, 2))
      feature_group_count=1
      lhs_dilation=(1, 1)
      out_sharding=None
      padding=((1, 1), (1, 1))
      precision=None
      preferred_element_type=None
      rhs_dilation=(1, 1)
      window_strides=(1, 1)
    ] c l
    o:f32[1,1,1,64] = broadcast_in_dim[
      broadcast_dimensions=(3,)
      shape=(1, 1, 1, 64)
      sharding=None
    ] d
    p:f32[1,1,1,64] = broadcast_in_dim[
      broadcast_dimensions=(3,)
      shape=(1, 1, 1, 64)
      sharding=None
    ] e
    q:f32[1,56,56,64] = sub n o
    r:f32[1,1,1,64] = add p 9.999999747378752e-06:f32[]
    s:f32[1,1,1,64] = rsqrt r
    t:f32[1,1,1,64] = reshape[
      dimensions=None
      new_sizes=(1, 1, 1, 64)
      sharding=None
    ] i
    u:f32[1,1,1,64] = mul s t
    v:f32[1,56,56,64] = mul q u
    w:f32[1,1,1,64] = reshape[
      dimensions=None
      new_sizes=(1, 1, 1, 64)
      sharding=None
    ] h
    x:f32[1,56,56,64] = add v w
    y:f32[1,56,56,64] = custom_jvp_call[
      name=relu
      call_jaxpr={ lambda ; z:f32[1,56,56,64]. let
          ba:f32[1,56,56,64] = jit[name=relu jaxpr=relu] z
        in (ba,) }
      jvp=jvp
      symbolic_zeros=False
    ] x
    bb:f32[1,56,56,64] = conv_general_dilated[
      batch_group_count=1
      dimension_numbers=ConvDimensionNumbers(lhs_spec=(0, 3, 1, 2), rhs_spec=(3, 2, 0, 1), out_spec=(0, 3, 1, 2))
      feature_group_count=1
      lhs_dilation=(1, 1)
      out_sharding=None
      padding=((1, 1), (1, 1))
      precision=None
      preferred_element_type=None
      rhs_dilation=(1, 1)
      window_strides=(1, 1)
    ] y m
    bc:f32[1,1,1,64] = broadcast_in_dim[
      broadcast_dimensions=(3,)
      shape=(1, 1, 1, 64)
      sharding=None
    ] f
    bd:f32[1,1,1,64] = broadcast_in_dim[
      broadcast_dimensions=(3,)
      shape=(1, 1, 1, 64)
      sharding=None
    ] g
    be:f32[1,56,56,64] = sub bb bc
    bf:f32[1,1,1,64] = add bd 9.999999747378752e-06:f32[]
    bg:f32[1,1,1,64] = rsqrt bf
    bh:f32[1,1,1,64] = reshape[
      dimensions=None
      new_sizes=(1, 1, 1, 64)
      sharding=None
    ] k
    bi:f32[1,1,1,64] = mul bg bh
    bj:f32[1,56,56,64] = mul be bi
    bk:f32[1,1,1,64] = reshape[
      dimensions=None
      new_sizes=(1, 1, 1, 64)
      sharding=None
    ] j
    bl:f32[1,56,56,64] = add bj bk
    bm:f32[1,56,56,64] = add c bl
    bn:f32[1,56,56,64] = custom_jvp_call[
      name=relu
      call_jaxpr={ lambda ; bo:f32[1,56,56,64]. let
          bp:f32[1,56,56,64] = jit[name=relu jaxpr=relu] bo
        in (bp,) }
      jvp=jvp
      symbolic_zeros=False
    ] bm
    bq:bool[1,56,56,64] = gt bn 0.0:f32[]
    br:i32[1,56,56,64] = convert_element_type[new_dtype=int32 weak_type=False] bq
    bs:i32[] = reduce_sum[axes=(0, 1, 2, 3) out_sharding=None] br
  in (bn, bs) }
